metadata.description: India-focused gap-filler skills for Claude: real estate, CA/accounting and legal. Free, no API keys. The curated list of trending repos lives in the README.

plugins.name: real-estate-india
plugins.description: Listings, lead follow-ups, buyer briefs and a due-diligence checklist for Indian real estate agents.

plugins.name: ca-accounting-india
plugins.description: GSTIN/invoice checks, client document reminders, notice reply drafts and bank statement categorising for CAs and bookkeepers.

plugins.name: legal-india
plugins.description: Contract risk review, legal notice drafts, client intake timelines and NDA drafting for Indian lawyers (drafts only, lawyer review required).
